name: sportlight
description: Sportlight — watch the most intense live sports moments, side by side.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sportlight/shared && npm run build -w @sportlight/backend -w @sportlight/publisher -w @sportlight/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sportlight/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,publisher,web -c gray,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @sportlight/shared" "npm run dev -w @sportlight/backend" "npm run dev -w @sportlight/publisher" "npm run dev -w @sportlight/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sportlight/shared && tsc -p apps/backend --noEmit && tsc -p apps/publisher --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
